items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, yeah. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, Bill Robinson. And a big bale of cottons on the stage...

ctx.x: I was saying, Robinson, Virick, Gass, and Elmery. So you joined Ori then? So I went down there and talked to Ori and Ori. That's because I come to the Royce and I went on to the Royce and I went on to the Royce and I never knew the tunes they were playing because there wasn't enough but to make up tunes out there in the country, you know. Oh, yeah. Like the 1919 and all that, you know.
